searchText: I noticed the same on my geth node when doing full sync after it was stuck due to me running an older branch I think this is related to the testing that Jochem did which makes it really slow for ELs to process blocks during sync what version of geth was it? i ran a full sync on mainnet yesterday and didn't notice an issue. Do you have logs of that time? It might've been the hard blocks that Jochem is sending. If they take 3+s to execute, you would take 3/12 of the time to catch up to head which can potentially be quite hard Many blocks used 150–184M gas and took 3–5s to execute, later some took 8–12s ``` Geth Version: 1.17.6-unstable Git Commit: 89def4a53b19dbb796d7ff81b438f50d270aaca0 ```

excerpts.content: Do you have logs of that time? It might've been the hard blocks that Jochem is sending. If they take 3+s to execute, you would take 3/12 of the time to catch up to head which can potentially be quite hard
